title.en: Community Pool Reception and Bookings Assistant
title.zh: 社区泳池接待与预订助理

vacancy_label: Synthetic vacancy; not a real opening

requirements.en: Process public-swim admissions and membership checks using reception systems.
requirements.zh: 使用接待系统处理公众游泳入场及会员检查。

requirements.en: Provide clear visitor information and follow capacity-escalation and lost-property procedures.
requirements.zh: 提供清晰访客信息，并遵循容量上报及失物处理流程。

requirements.en: Maintain accurate receipt reconciliations and report discrepancies.
requirements.zh: 维护准确的收款核对记录，并报告差异。

requirements.en: Be available for weekend daytime reception shifts.
requirements.zh: 可在周末日间接待班工作。

requirements.en: Independently administer swim-course waiting lists and allocate lesson places within supplied rules.
requirements.zh: 按所提供规则独立管理游泳课程候补名单并分配课程名额。
